skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions that already share a common denominator.

skills.name: Finding Common Denominators
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting unlike fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole Number Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the whole-number components of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing and Regrouping
skills.definition: Regrouping one whole unit into fraction form (d/d) to resolve a negative fraction subtraction step.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing the fractional part of the result to its lowest terms.
